Product initiative

StylePulse

Fashion trend intelligence to support better-informed demand decisions.

An initiative exploring how fashion brands and retailers could bring emerging trend signals into planning and merchandising conversations.

Register Interest

Concept / Customer Discovery

We are exploring customer needs. Features and availability are not confirmed; this is not a generally available product.

The business problem

Trend signals are scattered across channels, while merchandising teams need context they can assess alongside sales, inventory and market knowledge.

What we’re exploring

Bring signals together

Explore ways to organise relevant trend sources and make their provenance clear.

Add business context

Consider how emerging themes relate to a retailer’s categories, markets and planning decisions.

Support human judgement

Help teams compare signals and discuss uncertainty rather than treat a prediction as a guarantee.

Interested in StylePulse?

Exploring better ways to identify emerging fashion trends? Share your interest and let’s discuss your requirements.
